class.name: MultiMeshPoolKey2D
class.brief_description: GDScript-visible key identifying one exact object-pool bucket (amount_bullets + shape).
class.description: Create with [method make] or by setting [member amount_bullets] and [member shape_type]. [code]amount_bullets[/code] is bullets per multimesh (bucket identity, must equal spawn data transforms size). It is NOT the instance count — see [method BulletFactory2D.populate_bullets_pool] [code]instance_count[/code] for how many multimeshes to pre-create. Pass to [method BulletFactory2D.reset], [method BulletFactory2D.free_active_bullets], [method BulletFactory2D.free_disabled_bullets] and [method BulletFactory2D.free_bullets_pool]. Pass [code]null[/code] to affect all buckets, or a key for one exact bucket. Keys returned by [method BulletFactory2D.debug_get_bullets_pool_info] are one [MultiMeshPoolKey2D] per bucket. Internally the pool uses a plain value-type key for speed; this Resource is only the Godot boundary wrapper.

method.name: make
method.description: Creates a key for the exact bucket with [code]amount_bullets[/code] bullets per multimesh and PhysicsServer2D shape type.

members.member: Bullets per multimesh in this bucket (bucket identity). Must be >= 0 and match spawn data transforms size.
PhysicsServer2D shape type for this bucket. Use PhysicsServer2D.SHAPE_* (Circle=3, Rectangle=4, Capsule=5).
